text:
alex: Quick question — where do I find traces for customer `acme-inc` in the priv VPC? Need span-level errors and want to filter by environment (staging vs prod). Also curious what OTLP sampling rate we have for that tenant right now.

maria: For traces, start with the traces dashboard and the tenant-scoped grafana link: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/tenant-traces/tenant-traces?orgId=1&var-tenant=acme-inc
You can then use the `traceID` or service name filter.

alex: thanks — is there a short example query for the trace search box?

maria: yup — paste this into the jaeger backend search box: `service.name: "acme-app" AND tags.environment: "prod" AND error:true`
If you want to limit by span duration: `duration:>200ms`

sre-jen: Note that in priv VPC we ingest OTLP via collector -> OTLP gateway in the customer's network. If you need raw spans you can query the traces-api (internal) — ping me for access.

alex: where do I find the traces-api endpoint?

prashant: internal endpoint is `https://traces-api.internal.redwood/v1/search` — use token scoped to the tenant. Example curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TENANT_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"service":"acme-app","tags":{"environment":"prod","error":"true"}}' \\
  https://traces-api.internal.redwood/v1/search
```

alex: awesome. about sampling — is there a per-tenant sampling override?

maria: We have a global default (0.1) and a per-tenant override flag. For acme-inc we currently have `sampling.rate=0.05` in the priv-vpc config. That lives in the onboarding repo under `configs/privvpc/acme-inc/observability.yaml`

samir: small FYI — we rolled a change last week to add span-level drop metrics to Prom for the priv VPCs. Look for metric `otlp_spans_dropped_total{tenant=\"acme-inc\"}` in the tenant Prom remote write.

alex: perfect — where can I see the prom remote-write target for that tenant?

maria: Grafana has a quick link on the tenant page `Metrics -> Prometheus (remote)` or use this direct: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/tenant-metrics/tenant-metrics?var-tenant=acme-inc

prashant: If you need to reduce alert noise, check `alerts/privvpc/acme-inc/` in the alerting repo — we tuned a couple rules last month (high error-rate flapping). Also recommend bumping the evaluation window from 1m to 5m for those noisy rules.

alex: thanks. last thing — any quick troubleshooting steps if I don’t see spans?

sre-jen: checklist: 1) confirm OTLP exporter in customer side is pointed to our collector endpoint, 2) check TLS certs and token, 3) verify collector logs — `kubectl logs` on collector pod in their VPC (if onprem) or check `collector-<tenant>` logs in the `privvpc` stack, 4) check `otlp_spans_ingested_total{tenant=\"acme-inc\"}` in Prom.

ops-bot: deploy-bot triggered: observability-collector/acme-inc rolled to v1.12.4 (2023-11-10) :rocket:

alex: got it, thanks everyone. If I hit a permission wall I'll @sre-jen.

sre-jen: happy to help — DM me the tenant token or the traceID and I'll take a look. :thumbsup:
